notes.title: Lakshya Sen bled points on the block
notes.body: 10 points lost to block errors (8 into the net, 2 out). The single biggest fix available.

notes.title: Lee Zii Jia bled points on the block
notes.body: 10 points lost to block errors (4 into the net, 6 out). The single biggest fix available.

notes.title: Lee Zii Jia's push was their biggest weapon
notes.body: 6 of their 16 outright winners came from the push. Expect it — and train the counter.

notes.title: Lakshya Sen's push was their biggest weapon
notes.body: 5 of their 11 outright winners came from the push. Expect it — and train the counter.

notes.title: Lakshya Sen owned the big points
notes.body: From 18+ in a game, Lakshya Sen took 10 of the 15 points. Composure under pressure decided the tight stretches.

notes.title: Lee Zii Jia's errors were mostly unforced (71%)
notes.body: 27 of their 38 pressure-rated errors came from a comfortable position (<2.5 m/s required movement). These are free points to claw back — focus errors, not fitness.
